title: How many times each word
summary: Count each distinct word, listing them in the order they first appear.
hints: Keep an array of `struct { char word[64]; int count; }` that grows with `realloc`; for each word read, search the array linearly with `strcmp`.
If it is found add 1, otherwise append a new entry with count 1. Printing in array order is the order of first appearance.
